data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Wear OS support, providing watch shape and ambient mode widgets.
data.what_it_does: Offers Flutter support for Wear OS by Google. It provides specific widgets like WatchShape to determine if a watch is square or round, and AmbientMode to handle active and ambient watch face states.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application specifically for Wear OS devices.
You need to detect whether a watch screen is square or round.
You need to handle active and ambient watch modes.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile or desktop application.
Your target Android minSdkVersion cannot be set to at least 23.
strengths: Simplifies Wear OS development by handling old native boilerplate references automatically.
Provides intuitive widgets for watch shape and ambient mode state management.
weaknesses: Requires a minimum SDK version of 23.
Limited to specific Wear OS capabilities documented in the plugin.
data.setup_notes: You must set your minSdkVersion to 23.
